'''Scott Bacon''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2000 Tampa tournament]] on 19 June 2000 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Ultimate Power (superlaser, gunners)]], according to Neal Razi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d914">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-19-dredlox-s-anthology-in-tampa-6-19-00d914/ dredlox-s-anthology-in-tampa-6-19-00], DeckTech (Neal "Dredlox" Razi, 19 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-19-dredlox-s-anthology-in-tampa-6-19-00d914/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
